title: The Morning Digest: October 20, 2026
dek: Monday's settles were split by contract. Brent Dec26 settled at $109.55 and WTI Nov26, in thin trade ahead of its Tuesday expiry, settled at $103.66, while the more active WTI Dec26 settled lower at $98.54. Overnight Brent recovered to $110.10 and WTI Nov26 to $103.91 at 0319 GMT (Reuters), after Yemen's Houthis claimed attacks on Saudi energy and airport targets including an Aramco site at Yanbu, the Shaybah oilfield and Riyadh airport. Saudi authorities did not confirm the claims and Reuters could not independently verify them. Kpler's Monday print puts confirmed Hormuz flows at a seven-day average of 10.17 Mb/d, 41 percent below the prewar baseline. The diesel crack closed Monday at $102.98 on the validated history, back above $100. December WCS settled Monday at -$27.50 (ICE TMW settle, Oct 19) on zero lots, and the November Mainline apportionment notice, expected Monday, had not been published as of this edition. Saturn Oil & Gas announced a C$302 million acquisition of Corex Resources on Monday.
